description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): .GH DATA activities support GH's vision of evidence-driven programming and decision-making in the three global health strategic priorities of USAID. GH DATA services support the development of a 5-year Data Analytics Strategy for the GH Bureau which includes a governance schema, systems inventory and workforce planning recommendations. GH DATA provides analytics consultancy services and facilitates access to knowledge management platforms and analytics software in order to build data and visual analytics capacity of USAID staff. GH DATA also provides information technology support in the development of information and communications technology strategies, ongoing operations and maintenance for IT systems in need of web hosting, and Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) services to ensure IT projects are in compliance with federal laws and regulations... .
